title: [Salty's Services, Landing]
description: A tangle of ropes and netting hangs over a wide room off a narrow winding stairway.  Caught within the amalgamation are varied larger containers, lengths of wood, fishing poles, and tattered bits of clothing.  The room is relatively unadorned, except for triangle-shaped series of votive-topped barrels at its center.  Amidst the barrels, Administrator Salty stands, leaning on a propped-up driftwood sign atop one of the barrels, facing the stairway.
